content.text:
Committed as `9987455` on `demo/project-deletion` (not pushed, no branch switch). Working tree is clean.

## What was done

**Data layer** — `/home/user/chatdex/src/lib/db/understanding.ts`
New `deleteUnderstandingProject(id)`: a single Dexie transaction that removes the project row and everything scoped to it — `projectAssociations`, `understandingObjects` + their `understandingEvents`, `intentTraces`, `decisionTraces`, `preparedChanges`, question-first `investigationCases` (with `caseExhibits`/`reviewScopes`/`verdictRevisions`/`investigationFindings`), and the local-only `inspections` and `decisionDiffs`. It deliberately never touches `conversations`, `messages`, or `rawSources` — the same conversation can back several projects, so deleting the "lens" leaves the primary sources in place (the inverse of the existing `deleteConversation`, which drops associations but keeps synthesis). Rows are deleted individually rather than via table clears so the sync engine's `deleting` hooks emit one tombstone per synced row. Idempotent for unknown ids.

**Sync** — `/home/user/chatdex/src/lib/sync/engine.ts`
The incoming `understanding_project` tombstone case now calls the same cascade, so project-scoped rows (including local-only derived rows that never get their own tombstones) don't dangle on a second device. No new import cycle: the engine already imported from `../db`.

**UI** — `/home/user/chatdex/src/pages/ProjectOverviewPage.tsx`
A "Delete project" section at the bottom of the project overview (the `/projects/:id` page). First click opens an inline `alertdialog` naming the project and stating "Conversations are not deleted"; Cancel backs out with no side effects; "Delete permanently" runs the cascade, clears the `chatdex.lastProjectId`/`lastProjectSection` keys the workspace layout uses (so the app doesn't reopen onto a "Project not found" screen), toasts, and navigates to `/projects`. Styling follows the existing card + red-danger conventions already used across settings.

**Tests**
- `src/lib/db/understanding.test.ts` — three new cases: full cascade over `seedSampleWorkspace()` (asserts every touched table is emptied while conversation/message/rawSource counts are unchanged), cross-project isolation with a conversation shared by two projects, and unknown-id no-op.
- `src/pages/ProjectOverviewPage.test.tsx` (new) — confirm → cancel → confirm → delete flow, post-delete DB state, conversation/messages survive, navigation and localStorage cleanup.

## Verification
- `npm run typecheck` — clean
- `npm test` — 117 files, 951/951 passing
- `npm run lint` — clean

One thing worth knowing: `src/lib/db/localOnly.test.ts` text-scans the sync engine source and fails if it even *mentions* the local-only table names. My first engine comment named `inspections/decisionDiffs` and tripped it; I reworded the comment (the engine code itself never references those tables — the cascade lives in the db layer, which is where that audit wants it).
